mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month (FEDFUNDS falling) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% within the past month signals an imminent monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates robust aggregate demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST rising and RSAFS rising) fails to produce positive returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), the labor market is tight, leading to higher consumer spending and corporate profits, which drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the UNRATE < 4.0% condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month signals robust economic activity and corporate profitability, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods of rising INDPRO are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 850 thousand units signals weakening demand in the housing sector, which reduces consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances (HOUST < 850), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a coordinated monetary and labor market stimulus, which boosts economic growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing and labor market tightening
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS declining and UNRATE declining) fails to produce positive returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of strong industrial production (INDPRO > 100.5), manufacturing and supply chain activity are robust, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO > 100.5, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO > 100.5 condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
